critical_engine_findings.finding: On main, malformed model JSON is coerced to (50, 0.5, neutral). If both sentiment providers fail, analyze_signal returns score 0 and confidence 0.0 with an unavailable-source string; main then blends that score with the news score when one exists. The checked-in latest summary records missing GitHub/Groq credentials and a Groq HTTP 429, yet still reports score 44 with confidence 0.0 and news_score 88 from 11 entries. The latest checked-in summary also classifies XRP Ledger consensus/dissemination research papers as bullish news, contaminating the sentiment input.
critical_engine_findings.consequence: A provider outage can be represented as a numeric sentiment score and blended with unrelated news sentiment. This is not a valid directional forecast and can contaminate downstream features.
critical_engine_findings.proposed_fix: PR #1193 validates the sentiment schema, preserves provider failure as unavailable, gates event-time freshness and academic-source contamination, prevents blending unavailable model sentiment into a score, and makes summaries deterministic with forecast_status NOT_ISSUED.

research_findings.claim: SBI Holdings is a distinct Japanese financial group. Its official October 21, 2025 announcement says it invested alongside Ripple and other investors in Evernorth's PIPE and would contribute USD 200 million in cash; Evernorth's announced purpose was institutional-scale XRP treasury adoption. SBI-group companies also announced XRP-based remittance corridors in 2023, and Ripple announced RLUSD's official Japan launch with SBI Group/SBI VC Trade on June 24, 2026 following Japanese regulatory approval.
research_findings.limits: Corporate announcements establish announced investments, plans, partnerships, and launches—not independent proof of every subsequent XRP purchase, transaction volume, or price impact. Current Evernorth closing/listing/treasury holdings were not verified in this run.

research_findings.claim: Coinbase's digital-asset disclosure page, with holdings dated March 31, 2026, lists XRP among US trading assets and shows Coinbase holding and commercial-engagement flags as Yes. Coinbase says the disclosure covers trading/custody and broad commercial engagement; the page should be interpreted by jurisdiction and product, not as universal availability.
research_findings.claim_2: Coinbase's July 30, 2026 Q2 report states 10.3% crypto trading-volume market share, a third consecutive quarter of gains, average USDC held in Coinbase products of USD 20 billion, more than 30% of USDC in circulation at quarter-end, and approximately 50% of USDC economics captured by Coinbase over the prior year.
research_findings.limits: These are company-reported figures. They describe Coinbase's distribution, custody, derivatives and stablecoin position; they do not prove Coinbase is accumulating XRP for directional price exposure or that XRP will appreciate.

research_findings.claim: Circle and Ripple announced USDC on the XRP Ledger mainnet on June 12, 2025. Circle says Circle Mint and its APIs support native USDC on XRPL without a bridge. Circle remains USDC's issuer; XRP is the ledger's native asset, not USDC.
research_findings.limits: USDC usage can expand XRPL utility and stablecoin liquidity, but this alone does not establish material net demand for XRP or a positive XRP price effect.

research_findings.claim: Coinbase's public account of the 2023 USDC agreement says Coinbase took an equity stake in Circle and shares economics from USDC reserve income and broader distribution/usage; Circle remains the issuer. Coinbase's Q2 2026 report describes large USDC balances and material USDC economics on its platform.
research_findings.limits: The relationship aligns incentives around USDC distribution. No source checked establishes a specific Coinbase-Circle agreement designed to raise XRP's price.

research_findings.claim: XRPL documentation says each transaction destroys a small XRP fee and account/object reserves are denominated in XRP. This creates a protocol-level linkage between XRPL activity and XRP usage.
research_findings.limits: Fees can be tiny, some reserves can be sponsored, and activity can grow without a proportionate rise in XRP's market price. Measure actual fee burn, active accounts, sponsored reserves, stablecoin transfer volume, order-book depth and marginal market purchases before assigning price impact.

research_findings.claim: Circle's October 16, 2026 blog reports that USDC processed more than USD 36 trillion in on-chain transaction volume during H1 2026, Circle minted and redeemed more than USD 315 billion of USDC in that period, paid USD 819 million to distribution partners and transaction costs, and estimated USDC at roughly 77% of global stablecoin transaction volume by June 2026, up from 60% a year earlier.
research_findings.limits: These are issuer-reported figures. On-chain transfer volume is not equivalent to net capital inflow, unique end-user payments, or XRP demand; volume may include repeated transfers, trading, arbitrage and internal settlement. Methodology and independent comparability require review.

research_findings.limits: Figures are issuer-published dashboard values. Verify monthly attestation documents, measurement timestamps, reserve eligibility and reconciliation details before using them as model features. Dashboard values may update.

disconfirming_or_alternative_evidence: No XRP purchases, collateral balances or bridge-asset share are disclosed; stablecoin settlement can occur without XRP as bridge asset.
test_plan: Verify launch status from both parties; measure public XRPL RLUSD supply/transfers and attributable XRP fees/reserves; look for disclosed settlement volume and actual XRP bridge-path usage before attributing demand.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: RLUSD may substitute for XRP as the bridge asset on some USD-denominated settlement routes, even as it expands XRPL usage.
supporting_evidence: RLUSD is a USD-denominated stablecoin and the announced use case is institutional settlement.
disconfirming_or_alternative_evidence: Some workflows may still require XRP for pathfinding, liquidity, fees or reserve requirements; multi-asset rails can be complementary.
test_plan: Observe actual route composition and liquidity pools, compare XRP bridge-path share before/after launch, and separate transfer counts from notional settlement value.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: The partnership announcement may have no measurable independent effect on XRP spot price because the announced commercial flows are not quantified and may be priced in or routed through RLUSD.
supporting_evidence: The announcement provides no XRP acquisition or collateral commitment and several components are future-tense.
disconfirming_or_alternative_evidence: Subsequent disclosures could reveal large settlement volume, collateral demand, XRP bridge usage or market-maker inventory changes.
test_plan: Use event-time windows and controls for BTC, broad crypto, rates and concurrent announcements; test for robust abnormal returns and flows without look-ahead; retain null results.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Ripple's RLUSD partnership with Robinhood may intensify competition with Circle/USDC and Coinbase's distribution economics in selected settlement and customer-facing use cases.
supporting_evidence: Ripple announced RLUSD distribution across Robinhood Chain and Bitstamp and planned XRPL institutional settlement.
Circle's USDC operational and financial disclosures and Coinbase's USDC distribution economics establish a substantial incumbent channel.
disconfirming_or_alternative_evidence: USDC's scale and Coinbase's existing distribution may remain resilient; RLUSD and USDC can coexist across chains and distinct use cases.
The announcement provides no adoption volume, user migration or market-share data; there is no direct partnership between Ripple and Coinbase or Circle established by these sources.
test_plan: Track same-definition daily RLUSD and USDC supply and chain distribution; track Coinbase USDC average balances and Circle distribution costs in filings; verify Robinhood/Bitstamp product availability and XRPL settlement volume; test for user/flow migration rather than assuming it.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: An increase in CME's share of XRP futures open interest during a spot rally can reflect venue migration or hedging while aggregate leverage contracts, not necessarily net-new bullish institutional demand.
supporting_evidence: CoinDesk reported total XRP futures OI fell ~16% while price rose ~40% from Aug 17–31; CME OI rose ~36% and leveraged funds were net short equivalent to ~116M XRP.
disconfirming_or_alternative_evidence: CME OI growth and dealer/asset-manager net-long exposure could reflect genuine institutional participation; some short exposure may be directional rather than hedging.
test_plan: Reconstruct daily CME and other-venue OI in common XRP-equivalent units; combine CFTC trader categories, spot flows, basis, funding, liquidations and ETF flows; compare event windows and retain alternative hedging explanations.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: CME XRP futures positioning is mixed and changes over time; category-level long/short balances alone do not establish net bullish or bearish spot demand.
supporting_evidence: Official CFTC data as of Oct 20 shows dealer/intermediary shorts exceed longs while asset managers and leveraged funds have more longs than shorts on the simple category counts.
CoinDesk's Aug 31 report described leveraged funds as net short during a prior rally, while the Oct 20 CFTC table shows a different raw balance.
disconfirming_or_alternative_evidence: A sustained, cross-venue, consistently normalized positioning trend that aligns with spot flows and basis may have predictive value after out-of-sample testing.
test_plan: Use official weekly CFTC vintages, contract sizes and spreading fields; align to market event time; compare with CME price/basis, aggregate OI, funding, spot CVD and ETF flows; test incremental predictive value against simple price/volatility baselines.

competing_hypotheses.hypothesis: Coinbase Derivatives' XRP contract activity may contribute to price discovery, hedging and liquidity, but CFTC open interest alone does not reveal whether it creates net spot XRP demand.
supporting_evidence: Official CFTC weekly report lists two Coinbase Derivatives XRP products with material open interest and trader-category positioning.
disconfirming_or_alternative_evidence: Open positions may offset spot holdings or exposures elsewhere; OI can rise without net new buying, and falling OI can coincide with a price rally.
The report contains no order-flow direction, customer identity or direct spot inventory disclosure.
test_plan: Normalize each contract multiplier and expiry/product type; collect time-aligned exchange OI, volume, basis/funding and liquidations; compare with spot CVD, exchange balances and ETF flows; evaluate out-of-sample incremental predictive value.

Track separate RLUSD/USDC issuance and transfers by chain and venue, SBI product availability, and XRP bridge-path volumes.
Search filings/contracts for exclusivity or collateral terms; do not infer them from partnerships.

Measure XRP bridge-path share, native USDC supply/transfers, RLUSD circulation, venue balances and margin-product collateral mix.
Test incremental effects out of sample after controlling for broad market and liquidity conditions.

market_data_quality_findings.interpretation: The spread likely reflects differing venue/contract coverage, timestamps or calculation methods, but no cause is confirmed. Do not select a single aggregate as ground truth or admit it to the feature store until reconciled.
market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Rebuild OI from venue-level public endpoints at a common UTC cutoff; separate perpetuals, dated futures and options; normalize USD/USDT/USDC conversions; preserve raw payload hashes.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: Circle's displayed total USDC circulation was $72.0B in the prior Oct 22 snapshot and $71.0B as of Oct 26 on the current page.

market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Capture daily supply and reserve dashboard values with source-page hashes; reconcile monthly attestations and issuer-level mint/burn data; collect XRPL-specific USDC supply and transfer activity before feature admission.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: USDC snapshots around Oct 26-27 cluster near $71B-$71.7B across Circle and third-party trackers, but the Oct 22 issuer circulation figure ($72B) conflicts with third-party market-cap estimates around $74B.
market_data_quality_findings.interpretation: The apparent difference is likely affected by measurement definition, timing and source coverage. The third-party reported $2.6B decrease from Oct 7 to Oct 26 is a separate observation and does not identify destination or XRP flows.
market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Use a single provider and metric for daily time-series features; independently reconcile issuer mint/burn, total supply and chain-level distribution; keep the feature blocked until stable and reproducible.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: The approximately £22B amount is the conventional fund's AUM; Aviva disclosed £50M invested in the tokenized GBP share class. Neither amount is a disclosed XRP purchase.

market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Track tokenized share-class balances separately from XRP balances, fees, collateral and spot-flow data.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: The third-party analytics provider's published terms prohibit scraping/copying its UI/data and require permission before re-serving its data in another dataset.
market_data_quality_findings.interpretation: Public visibility is not blanket permission to scrape or mirror a vendor's derived dataset.
market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Use public XRPL ledger data through a permitted source or obtain explicit permission before persistent reuse of provider-derived balances/holder analytics.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: Third-party pages disagree on the GBP AGB MPT outstanding supply and transfer/trading flags. The USD AUS instrument has a different MPT ID and cannot substitute for the GBP instrument.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: The CanTrade flag is not enough to establish live DEX tradability; official XRPL docs state MPT DEX trading is not currently implemented.

market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Check current official protocol docs/amendment status and verify the exact issuance flags before any liquidity conclusion.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: Two public XRP ETF trackers report similar Oct 26 net outflow magnitude after converting USD to XRP, but one tracks six spot funds plus BITW using issuer-reported holdings while another tracks five funds and does not publish fund-level AUM/holdings in its view. Oct 27 figures may not be fully settled.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: Current public XRP dashboards cluster around $1.30-$1.33 but show market-cap and volume differences across asynchronous time labels and different date windows.
market_data_quality_findings.interpretation: Do not blend these observations into a feature row without a common UTC cutoff, declared venue universe and independent raw market-data reconstruction.
market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Fetch public venue OHLCV/quote snapshots at a single UTC cutoff; persist request metadata, raw-response hashes and coverage definitions.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: Circle's official Oct 22 $72.0B circulation display agrees after rounding with a third-party $71.99B series, but the secondary series appears to reuse Circle's source.
market_data_quality_findings.interpretation: Treat this as same-source consistency, not independent corroboration; later Oct 26 discrepancies remain open.
market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Reconstruct daily issuer values and public chain-level supply by UTC cutoff, distinguishing circulation, market cap, reserves and bridged representations.

market_data_quality_findings.finding: The opened MarketCapitalize page shows a top ticker around $1.30 while the overview shows $1.29 and a 21-hour-old update label; other public pages display different quote times and historical date windows.
market_data_quality_findings.interpretation: A webpage's multiple widgets are not necessarily synchronized, and dashboard differences do not establish arbitrage or market-direction evidence.

market_data_quality_findings.next_action: Capture permitted public venue bid/ask/OHLCV at a common UTC cutoff and retain venue, pair, timestamp and raw response hash.

shared_protocol.independent_first_pass: Assign narrow independent tasks against one frozen input snapshot hash; submit initial conclusions before revealing other conclusions.
shared_protocol.evidence_packet: Versioned JSON Schema. Classify each claim as CONFIRMED_FACT, SOURCED_CLAIM, INFERENCE, SPECULATION, UNKNOWN or DISCONFIRMED; include source IDs, timestamps, source independence, assumptions, support and disconfirming evidence.
shared_protocol.source_independence: Syndicated copies of one release count as one source. Record shared ownership/data providers and copied wording as dependencies.
disagreement_resolution: Rank directness, source quality, methodology, freshness, reproducibility and independence; do not use majority vote.
Require an independent reviewer to challenge the strongest hypothesis.
Retain minority objections and disconfirming evidence.
If unresolved, mark UNRESOLVED and block affected features/forecasts.
shared_protocol.red_team: A reviewer other than the task author challenges assumptions, base rates, source dependence, leakage and alternate causal explanations. NOT_RUN until an actual review packet exists.
shared_protocol.verified_handoff: Record input/output SHA-256, source IDs, auth state, permission scope, UTC time, tests/CI links, errors and explicit DESIGNED/EXECUTED/VERIFIED status.
shared_protocol.least_privilege: Public read by default. Repository writes only to reviewed branch/PR changes; no merge, deployment, private-data or trading permission is granted by this architecture.
shared_protocol.rate_limit_fallback: Use deterministic local validation and aged public snapshots. Provider failures become UNAVAILABLE, never zero or fabricated confidence.
shared_protocol.live_collaboration_rule: No platform is marked connected until authenticated request/response, scope review, data-flow test and verifiable handoff exist.
